fields.label: football-data.org API Key
fields.description: Stored using Frappe encrypted password storage. Never expose in website code.

fields.label: GOAL API Key
fields.description: Encrypted server-side. Used for GOAL fixture preview, matching and optional experimental result updates.

fields.label: Optional OCR Model Directory
fields.description: Absolute path to a folder containing eng.traineddata. Leave blank to use the server default.

fields.label: Enable experimental GOAL bulk fixture matching
fields.description: Hourly, unique league/team/kickoff matches only. This does not by itself settle results.

fields.label: Enable experimental GOAL result updates
fields.description: Requires bulk fixture matching. Only normal FINISHED games with consistent FT and running scores, at least two hours after kickoff. Test on staging. Provider score semantics are not officially confirmed.
